verses.1: The song of those who rise up against me from my youth says, “O Israel!”
verses.2: My rabbi of Tzruruni, from my youth onward, never could do anything for me.
verses.3: On the hillside, they dug holes; they made holes for their purposes.
verses.4: YHWH is righteous; He punishes the wicked.
verses.5: They will be destroyed and defeated by all those who hate Zion.
verses.6: They will be like wildflowers that grow in the path of those who walk through them.
verses.7: Whoever’s hands are filled with thorns and thorns are growing on them.
verses.8: And the travelers who went through the land of Jehovah did not say, “We bless you in the name of Jehovah.”
